title: 小五人物物品表：队伍出行
audio_introduction: Look at the four people and the five things. Listen to the letter and choose who prepared each thing.
instruction: 听一封完整书信三遍，在四人五物品表中为每件物品选准备它的人。每列一个人，同一人可准备多件，共5项分配，不是20道题。本机前后25秒、重播间25秒及提示只作审阅编排，可重播，不冒精确源时序。
source_form_notice: 小五同一公开期末卷：一完整书信、四人行五物品列、短文三遍；Grandma对应两件，不能误作五人一一配对。原表图片列头/键布局尚未完整核，印本脚本可核、原音轨缺。标题地域/学校施测未认证，原键不当gold；自有图音不补平源缺口。
format_summary: 1完整书信 / 4人行×5物品列 / 5分配回应 / 一人可多物品 / 3遍

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Dear Ruby, Everyone has helped with our team outing. Mum chose a hat for you and filled a water bottle. Dad found a sandwich in the kitchen and packed it for your lunch. Alex got a map so that we can find the right path. Aunt Lucy brought a football for the game after lunch. These are the five things we have prepared. We are looking forward to seeing you. Love, Tom
